description: text-wrap: balance as Chromium 153 lays it out (Blink's LineBreakStrategy: the score line breaker, else bisecting the width, for the first paragraph of at most six lines): a centred heading, two break opportunities in a narrow box (bisected), one line (unchanged), justified text (no line penalty), a text-indent, a forced break (pre-line: only the first paragraph balanced), bold, larger and bordered inline elements, the text-wrap-style longhand with letter spacing, a balancing span in a greedy paragraph (ignored: the block container decides), and text and class changed at run time. Chromium breaks 7 of the 10 balanced paragraphs differently from greedy wrapping at 420px and 8 at 800px. The last word of each paragraph has an id, so geometry checks where the lines break
